purpose: Offline candidate inventory for the existing installed OBS 32.1.0 host tree; no files copied and no guest/runtime started.

hostInstalledTree.peCountDifference: 87 host PE files minus exactly one excluded uninstall.exe equals 86 PE files included and analyzed

totals.peCountBasis: 86 candidate PE files import-scanned; 87 PE files exist in host tree, and the sole excluded PE is uninstall.exe.

peDirectImportAnalysis.method: objdump -p import table; direct imports only; delay-load, LoadLibrary, runtime behavior and GPU/driver needs are not covered

hostVCRuntimeObserved.guestPrerequisite: Guest must already satisfy imports; no redistributable was located or bundled.
hostVCRuntimeObserved.scope: File version read from host System32 only; not proof of guest availability.

limitations: A Program Files installation is not a validated portable distribution.
No installer was found in inspected locations; installer is optional only if portable closure is proven.
No guest launch, process monitor, plugin load, graphics check, or network check has been performed.
Direct PE imports do not reveal all dynamic or delay-loaded dependencies.
User profile, scenes, settings, plugins outside this Program Files tree, and credentials are excluded.
